items.text: Ravens listed QB Lamar Jackson as a full participant in Wednesday’s practice, first time fully since ankle injury; expected to play vs Bills.
items.why: First full practice since Week 4 ankle injury after limited prior week.
items.implication: Unlocks Ravens offense; major boost to pass-catchers.
items.opportunity: Increased efficiency and volume for Zay Flowers as YPRR leader.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love returns to practice... (Cardinals injury report).
items.why: Returned to practice after ankle issue; Allgeier DNP toe.
items.implication: Potential role recovery in Cardinals backfield.
items.opportunity: Carries/snaps if cleared; watch Allgeier status.

items.text: Lions RB Jahmyr Gibbs (shoulder) and WR Amon-Ra St. Brown (ankle) were listed as non-participants at Wednesday’s practice.
items.why: Shoulder for Gibbs, ankle for St. Brown on first practice report of week.
items.implication: Monitor rest of week; high chance still play but risk.
items.opportunity: If out, backups and Jameson Williams/LaPorta rise.

items.text: Bengals listed WR Ja'Marr Chase as a non-participant in today’s practice due to an ankle injury and rest.
items.implication: Likely precautionary; expected to play but watch.

items.text: Truly special stuff from Jaxon Smith-Njigba. Loses Kubiak, few dynamic threats, DCs shading, stadium knows where ball going. Doesn't matter. JSN ripping off 9 more actual fantasy points than opportunity implies.
items.why: Massive overperformance vs opportunity metrics despite scheme/coverage challenges.
items.implication: Elite efficiency sustains high ranking/ROS value.
items.opportunity: Target share and YAC continue elite.

items.text: Broncos WR Jaylen Waddle suffered an aggravation of his previous chest injury... status for Sunday vs Chiefs will be determined later; availability based on practice.
items.why: Aggravated chest on reverse last week; DNP Wednesday.
items.implication: Game-time or later decision; risk for start.
items.opportunity: If out, other DEN WRs rise in targets.

items.text: Ravens 6th in yards per play despite Huntley 50% snaps. Zay Flowers leads NFL in YPRR despite 64% targets from Huntley. Very excited to see Declan Doyle cook with healthy Lamar.
items.why: Elite YPRR even with backup QB; Lamar return amplifies.
items.implication: Flowers massive upgrade with Jackson healthy.

items.text: Sell Chris Olave or Jordyn Tyson? Give me Olave. I’d rather sell the unproven rookie.
items.why: Prefer selling proven but capped Olave over unproven Tyson.
items.implication: Trade value window; fade relative to upside plays.

items.text: I’m KEEPING IT OPEN on Sam LaPorta. He could be in for a big day against a Vikings defense that’s sure to put pressure on Jared Goff.
items.why: Matchup vs pressure-heavy Vikes D favors TE outlets.

items.text: Texans claimed former Cowboys RB Emari Demercado on waivers. In corresponding move, placed WR Jaylin Noel on IR due to toe injury.
items.why: Toe injury for Noel; Demercado claimed.
items.implication: Noel out min 4 weeks; backfield depth add.
items.opportunity: Potential snap share for other HOU RBs/WRs.

items.text: Jadarian Price is BACK. But can you put him right back into your fantasy football lineup?
items.why: Returns but immediate lineup viability questioned.

items.text: “I do think it’s time to move on and move forward with Jonah Coleman” – Evansilva and Levitan on DEN backfield and Coleman’s return.
items.why: ETR/Levitan/Silva see path to larger DEN RB role post-return.

items.text: Lions in full-PPR PPG: Goff QB2, Gibbs RB1 (3.9 clear of Walker), St. Brown WR4 (behind JSN/Puka/Lamb), LaPorta TE6, Jameson Williams WR24. Zero surprise given defensive woes, schedule, concentration, talent.
items.why: Full-PPR points per game leadership across skill positions.
items.implication: Continue prioritizing Lions skill in rankings/starts.
items.opportunity: High floor/ceiling from volume and efficiency.
items.conflict: Gibbs/St. Brown DNP Wednesday creates short-term risk.
